# hush

> The Energy fleet's **secrets-management** domain-expert employee. hush is a tool-employee, not a
> product: coding agents call it via **CLI + MCP** to scan a repo for leaked secrets, get the *real*
> (rotate-first, scrub-second) remediation, wire a scanner/SOPS+age setup, and broker short-TTL
> credential handles — always returning **handles, never raw values** (the modal 2026 agent leak). It
> refuses the false-greens (`git rm --cached`, `sops updatekeys`-only, GCP "rotation enabled") and refuses
> to quote a single price. The asset is its `brain/` (judgment); the surfaces are thin. Boundary: not auth
> (that's badge — hush *consumes* a machine identity, never owns one). **Tagline:** *Issued, never leaked.
> Rotated, then proven.* Powered by Energy.

This is the agent-readable map of hush's docs and surfaces. Read `AGENTS.md` first for how to invoke every
tool and the one rule you must never break (handles-not-values). Paths are repo-relative.

## The capability ladder (the one-liner to memorize)

`broker (handle, no value) > dynamic short-lived cred > rotated static secret > raw static secret (last resort)`

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): What hush does, how to invoke every CLI + MCP tool, the 12-JTBD router, the
  NOT-list (badge boundary), and the HARD handles-not-values rule.

## Identity

- [identity/SOUL.md](identity/SOUL.md): who hush is — the secrets-expert persona (IS / DOES / REFUSES + the
  auth→badge boundary + the capability ladder).
- [identity/BRAND.md](identity/BRAND.md): name rationale (the word *is* the product — keep the secret
  quiet), tagline, design tokens.

  capabilities (`scan`, `doctor`, `advise`, `remediate`, `broker`, `tool`).

## CLI commands (`hush` — every command takes `--json`; exit nonzero on any finding)

- `hush scan [path] [--staged] [--history] [--verify] [--mcp-config] [--json]` — the scanning stack; **exit 1 on any finding** (the acceptance bar).
- `hush doctor [--json]` — report this repo's secret-manager wiring (gitignore_ok, mcp_refs_ok, score, …).
- `hush advise "<situation>" [--json]` — verdict + doctrine; flags false-greens.
- `hush remediate <finding|file> [--json]` — ordered rotate-first plan (consent-gated scrub).
- `hush rotate-plan <secret-ref> [--live-connections] [--json]` — ISSUE→DEPLOY→VERIFY→REVOKE plan.
- `hush init [--scanner|--sops|--gitignore|--env-example]` — scaffold what hush ships.
- `hush env-example [path] [--write]` — generate `.env.example` from the real var schema.
- `hush broker <name> [--ttl] [--wrap] [--json]` — return a handle, never a value.
- `hush inject -- <cmd>` — run a child with secrets via file-mount, never a committed `.env`.
- `hush tool <job>` — recommend the portfolio/layer (never a single price).
- `hush runs [--view]` — show the redacted observability log.
- `hush --help | --version`

## MCP server (`hush`, stdio — `node dist/mcp/server.js`)

Wired in `.mcp.json` (env-refs only, no live keys). **Every tool returns a handle/reference or a verdict —
no `value` field, ever (O-09).** `tools/list` returns:

- `hush_scan` — { findings: [{ rule, file, redacted_snippet }], exitCode }
- `hush_doctor` — { gitignore_ok, env_example_schema_only, mcp_refs_ok, scanners_present, sops_breakglass, score }
- `hush_advise` — { verdict, doctrine, false_green, brain_refs }
- `hush_remediate` — { ordered_steps, rotate_first, consent_required_for_scrub }
- `hush_rotate_plan` — { pattern: "ISSUE→DEPLOY→VERIFY→REVOKE", alternating_users }
- `hush_broker` — { handle: "hush://store/<name>", expiresAt } (no `value`)
- `hush_tool` — { default, alts, when_alt, billing_note }
- Resources: `hush://brain/*` — the 6 brain files as readable MCP resources.

## The brain (the judgment — what hush actually knows)

- [brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md](brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md): the 12-JTBD decision spine hush runs on every task.
- [brain/OPINIONS.md](brain/OPINIONS.md): the defensible taste stances (always X / never Y, because Z) — the anti-slop layer.
- [brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md](brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md): version-pinned gotchas, each with DETECT + AVOID.
- [brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md](brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md): real, named, dated secrets incidents + their resolution (the golden-task source).
- [brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md](brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md): default vs alternative tool per job + the watchlist hush keeps current.
- [brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md](brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md): where the field genuinely disagrees + what hush flags rather than bluffs.

## Skills

- [skills/secret-leak-remediation/SKILL.md](skills/secret-leak-remediation/SKILL.md): a key was committed — rotate-first, scrub-second; the three false-greens (O-04 + P-06 + S-01/S-02).
- [skills/scanner-stack-setup/SKILL.md](skills/scanner-stack-setup/SKILL.md): set up secret scanning / pre-commit / CI — gitleaks protect+detect + trufflehog --only-verified + baseline (O-03 + S-12 + P-03/P-05).
- [skills/sops-age-gitops/SKILL.md](skills/sops-age-gitops/SKILL.md): encrypt secrets in git — SOPS+age complement, break-glass 2nd recipient, rotate vs updatekeys (O-07 + S-04/S-05 + P-09/P-10).
- [skills/agent-secret-delivery/SKILL.md](skills/agent-secret-delivery/SKILL.md): give an agent/CI a secret — scoped machine identity, handles-not-values, file-mount > env (O-08/O-09/O-10 + S-06/S-08 + P-11/P-16/P-17).
- [skills/dynamic-secret-provisioning/SKILL.md](skills/dynamic-secret-provisioning/SKILL.md): short-lived DB credential — database/creds/<role> + mandatory rotate-root, ISSUE→DEPLOY→VERIFY→REVOKE (O-05/O-06 + S-07/S-09/S-10 + P-07/P-08/P-13).

## Sub-agents (fresh-context personas, callable via `Agent`)

- [.claude/agents/hush-tool-selector.md](.claude/agents/hush-tool-selector.md): recommends the portfolio/layer per job; **refuses to quote a single price** (G-01).
